_doc: Emergency services as real places (task 12.3). The stations are lots of the map (the fire station is its own lot on the east side of the map; a world without it falls back to the police lot). Response time = call handling + turnout (crew in the station, staffing from the budget) + the drive (distance, siren speed, traffic, lights, road works) + a wait when every unit is already out. Minutes in game minutes.

text.on_way: An ambulance is on its way. It should be here in about {min} minutes.
text.late: The ambulance took {min} minutes. {name} got worse while waiting.
text.fire_arrived: The fire engine arrived after {min} minutes.
text.police_arrived: A patrol car arrived after {min} minutes.
